ClientResponses.Response:
We apologize for your frustration, that is not the experience we want our loyal Weber fans to have. There are a few things we would like to check. Let's start with the easy stuff. 

Check all gas connections for a gas leak by spraying each connection with a soapy water solution. If the solution begins to bubble, this indicates a gas leak. 

Your grill should be able to reach the same high temperature we expect from all of our grills, at least 450 F. If your grill is not getting that hot, we would also suggest double-checking your current gas pressure. The gas pressure provided to the grill is of the utmost importance, it affects the performance of the burner tube(s).

The bypass safety feature could have been activated. This can happen by turning the grill on too quickly or in the wrong order. 

Here is a helpful link on "bypass" for review:
https://consumer-care.weber.com/hc/en-us/articles/4977762826516-My-propane-gas-grill-isn-t-getting-very-hot-How-do-I-fix-this-

We are looking into what caused this matter so we can provide further assistance, our kind Support team would like to follow up with you. Please be on the lookout for an email, thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
